rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Begin from the recovered weighted-threshold counterfamilies already disproving three conditional-input normalization/total-correlation payments in paper/biased.tex. Prove a replacement estimate that survives those controls and could extend corrected FEI+ to arbitrary real weights with an arity-independent constant. Preserve the coefficient-one scope of the pivotal-credit failure and distinguish conditional-input TC from spectral good-coordinate erasure.

deliverables.description: WEIGHTED_THRESHOLD_REPLACEMENT.tex: new inequality replacing the failed symmetric-proof payments
WEIGHTED_GUARD_LEDGER.md: three recovered no-go families and surviving scope

acceptance_criteria: Import all three failures from reductions/paper/biased.tex: event total-correlation payment, coefficient-one pivotal normalization credit, and conditional-input-TC existential-coordinate payment.
Test the two-branch weighted threshold A_m={mX_0+ΣX_j≥m} in the stated q/q_0 regimes before advancing any replacement; convert nats/bits exactly.
Do not generalize the pivotal-credit failure beyond coefficient one, or confuse conditional-input TC with the still-open spectral B_i selection problem.
Any claimed corrected FEI+ extension must be uniform in arity, real weights, product biases, and deterministic endpoints, with a complete composition implication.

advisory_upstream.interface: endpoint expansions for the weighted counterfamily

next_consumers.interface_use: failures that a new weighted/gate payment must survive

assignments.renewal_milestone: A replacement lemma that survives all three known weighted controls and pays a precise missing term, even on a new restricted weight class.

assignments.target_statement: Analyze limits as selected input probabilities tend to zero or one. Derive symbolic expansions for corrected FEI+ and I-Var, including zero-deficit and unit-atom endpoints.

deliverables.description: BIASED_ENDPOINT_SERIES.tex: symbolic zero/one-bias and zero-deficit expansions
WEIGHTED_CONTROL_LIMITS.json: exact regimes and proven remainder ranges

acceptance_criteria: For the q=m^(−2) weighted family retain the event-TC and pivotal residual divergences while the genuine corrected entropy/deficit ratio tends to its finite limit.
For the separate η=1/2, q→0 then m→∞ regime, verify the conditional-input-TC every-coordinate obstruction in its exact order of limits.
Contract deterministic coordinates and state whether each expansion is uniform in m, weights, or bias; a fixed-m series cannot certify an all-arity limit.

next_consumers.interface_use: endpoint expansions for the weighted counterfamily

assignments.renewal_milestone: A reusable exact endpoint certificate distinguishes failed auxiliary payments from the still-viable corrected FEI+ theorem.

assignments.target_statement: Factor Boolean functions under genuine disjoint composition and identify remaining irreducible gates. Prove what a uniform theorem on that precisely defined prime class would imply.

deliverables.description: PRIME_GATE_DEFINITION.tex: factorization notion and existence/termination theorem
PRIME_ENDPOINT_IMPLICATION.md: bias and arity quantifiers with exact constant

acceptance_criteria: Define irreducibility under genuine disjoint composition, including constants, literals, and parity conventions.
Prove the decomposition terminates and the required product measures/means are inherited correctly.
Show exactly what an arity-uniform theorem on the remaining primes implies, without treating the theorem on all primes as an already easier or proved input.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A correct decomposition/implication theorem plus one structural restriction on a nontrivial prime family.

assignments.target_statement: Seek an arity-uniform corrected FEI+ inequality for a new explicit gate family. Give a composition corollary whose depth and fan-in dependence are completely controlled.

deliverables.description: NEW_GATE_CLASS_FEIPLUS.tex: explicit gate class and arity-uniform inequality
DEPTH_INDEPENDENT_COROLLARY.tex: read-once substitution with all mean/bias conditions

acceptance_criteria: Name a gate family outside the already covered symmetric-threshold/parity result and verify novelty against primary sources.
Prove all normalization and boundary terms with the same constant for every allowed arity; inherited biases cannot be restricted after composition.
Replay applicable weighted no-go controls and state which structural hypothesis changes their conclusion, then prove depth-independent closure.

advisory_upstream.interface: failures that a new weighted/gate payment must survive

assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete new class theorem or a decisive obstruction to the proposed class's auxiliary estimate.

assignments.target_statement: Check that a proposed biased spectral law is the normalized product Fourier law of an actual Boolean gate. Audit deterministic inputs, repeated variables, and the distinction between physical and spectral conditioning.

deliverables.description: BIASED_REALIZABILITY_AUDIT.md: inverse product-Fourier and norm checks
GATE_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.json: deterministic, repeated-variable, and conditioning cases

acceptance_criteria: Normalize coefficients in the actual product orthonormal basis and prove the inverse is a Boolean gate at every positive-mass input.
Handle probability-zero/one coordinates by contraction; repeated physical variables invalidate a claimed disjoint product law unless separately proved.
Replay the three weighted control failures, distinguishing conditional-input TC, spectral conditional entropy, and the coefficient-one pivotal-credit scope.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One complete gate/candidate normalization review with an exact accepted domain or a concrete witness of failure.
